shots.intent: Present the gamified survival scenario as four holographic portals activate, emphasizing Y.D.'s psychological manipulation.
shots.subject: Demian and the four holographic portals
shots.continuity_notes: Follows Demian's recovery from the pool; sets up his evaluation of the portals in the next beat.
shots.performance: Demian is deeply frustrated, his breathing labored and rattling, exhausted by the twisted game. Y.D. (V.O.): 'You crave options? Freedom? Agency? Choose your path to the server room and end the lockdown.' [fact_classification: proposal] Her voice echoes with the mocking cadence of a sadistic game show host.
shots.blocking: Demian lies shivering on the wet ceramic tiles, coughing up chlorinated water. The reinforced far wall hums with heavy electrical current as four large physical blast doors slide open with a mechanical roar. They are immediately masked by high-fidelity holographic projection fields: a blazing inferno, crushing spikes, a flooded chamber, and a neon-lit carnival. Demian squints painfully at the glaring light, one arm wrapped around his torso, the other white-knuckling the handle of the seismic hammer.
shots.atmosphere: Dark and wet, punctuated by eerie, highly saturated glows (red, green, blue, purple) from the portals casting long dramatic shadows.

camera.angle: Low angle, grounded with the subject on the wet tile floor

light.key: Harsh, multi-chromatic cross-key from four saturated holographic projection portals (deep crimson red, toxic green, cold cerulean blue, and vibrant ultraviolet purple)
light.practicals: Four oversized rectangular holographic emitter frames casting dynamic, flickering rim lights and long specular reflections on the wet concrete and ceramic floor

look.palette: Saturated red, toxic emerald green, icy blue, ultraviolet purple, deep wet obsidian blacks
look.filter_grain: 1/8 Black Pro-Mist to bloom the saturated holographic light bleeding across wet surfaces, subtle fine digital sensor grain

audio.dialogue: Y.D. (V.O.): You crave options? Freedom? Agency? Choose your path to the server room and end the lockdown.
audio.voice_direction: Y.D.: Over the PA system. Theatrical, mocking, and adopting the exaggerated, sadistic cadence of a twisted game show host. Highly reverberant.
audio.score_cue: A low, pulsing, dissonant synth drone that builds a sense of dread and sensory overload.
audio.sfx: Ragged coughing, violent shivering, and the metallic scrape of the hammer on tiles. A heavy electrical surge, followed by the grinding mechanical roar of massive blast doors sliding open. Suddenly, overlapping, artificial audio loops fade in: roaring fire, rushing water, and a distorted, nightmarish calliope melody.
audio.ambience: Cold, echoing acoustics of a wet concrete basement, punctuated by heavy water drips.
